scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays correctly with project name, tagline, CTAs, and visual elements as specified in REQ-1

steps.description: Navigate to the MirDB homepage in a web browser
steps.context: Homepage must be accessible and fully rendered

steps.description: Check that the hero section is prominently displayed at the top of the page
steps.context: Hero section should be the first major content block visible

steps.description: Confirm project name (MirDB), tagline, and one-sentence description are present
steps.context: Description should read: 'A persistent key-value store with Memcached protocol compatibility'

steps.description: Check that 'Get Started' and 'View on GitHub' buttons are visible and clickable
steps.context: Buttons should be prominently styled and accessible

test_cases.input: Load homepage and inspect hero section DOM structure
test_cases.expected: Hero section contains h1 with 'MirDB', tagline text, description paragraph, and two CTA buttons
User is scrolled or navigated to the Quick Start section
User is navigated to the MirDB GitHub repository in a new tab

test_cases.input: Check for visual element (logo/graphic) in hero section
test_cases.expected: A logo, ASCII art representation, or animated graphic is present

scenarios.name: Features Showcase Section
scenarios.description: Verify the features section displays all key MirDB features in an organized card-based layout as specified in REQ-2

steps.description: Scroll or navigate to the features showcase section of the homepage
steps.context: Features section should be easily discoverable

steps.description: Verify all six feature cards are displayed
steps.context: Features: Memcached Protocol, Persistence, LSM Tree, High Performance, Rust Implementation, Skip List

steps.description: Check each feature card has a title, icon/visual, and description text
steps.context: Descriptions should accurately explain each feature's benefit

test_cases.input: Query DOM for feature cards in features section
test_cases.expected: Exactly 6 feature cards are rendered with titles: Memcached Protocol Support, Persistence, LSM Tree Architecture, High Performance, Rust Implementation, Skip List

test_cases.input: Check feature card for Memcached Protocol Support
test_cases.expected: Card contains description about compatibility with existing memcached clients
Card contains description about data surviving restarts unlike traditional memcached

test_cases.input: Check feature card for LSM Tree Architecture
test_cases.expected: Card contains description about efficient storage with memtables and SSTable compaction

test_cases.input: Verify feature cards grid layout on desktop (1024px+)
test_cases.expected: Features display in a 3-column grid layout

scenarios.name: Architecture Overview Section
scenarios.description: Verify the architecture section provides a clear visual and textual explanation of MirDB's LSM tree structure as specified in REQ-3

steps.description: Scroll or navigate to the architecture overview section
steps.context: Architecture section should provide technical details for systems architects

steps.description: Check that a visual diagram of the LSM tree structure is displayed
steps.context: Diagram can be SVG, Mermaid.js rendered, or static image

steps.description: Check that the write path is explained: WAL -> Memtable -> Immutable Memtable -> SSTables
steps.context: Write path should be clearly documented with visual or textual representation

steps.description: Check that the read path is explained: Memtable -> Immutable Memtables -> SSTable levels
steps.context: Read path should show the lookup order

test_cases.input: Check for architecture diagram element (SVG, canvas, or image)
test_cases.expected: Architecture diagram is present and visible showing LSM tree structure

test_cases.input: Search for write path text content
test_cases.expected: Page contains explanation mentioning WAL, Memtable, Immutable Memtable, and SSTables in write context

test_cases.input: Search for read path text content
test_cases.expected: Page contains explanation of read lookup order through memtable and SSTable levels
Page contains explanation of minor and major compaction processes

test_cases.input: Check diagram accessibility (alt text or aria-label)
test_cases.expected: Architecture diagram has appropriate alt text for screen readers

scenarios.name: Quick Start Guide Section
scenarios.description: Verify the quick start section provides complete instructions for getting MirDB running as specified in REQ-4

steps.description: Click 'Get Started' CTA or scroll to the quick start guide section
steps.context: Section should be reachable within 2 clicks per success metrics

steps.description: Check for clear installation commands (cargo build or Docker)
steps.context: Instructions should be copy-pasteable

steps.description: Check for a basic configuration file example
steps.context: Configuration should show key options with comments

steps.description: Check for client connection and basic operations examples (get, set, delete)
steps.context: Code should be syntax highlighted and demonstrate real usage

test_cases.input: Check for installation code block with cargo build command
test_cases.expected: Code block contains 'cargo build --release' or equivalent installation command
Code block shows how to start mirdb-server with configuration file
Sample code demonstrates set, get, and delete operations
Configuration block shows addr, work_dir, and key size limit options

test_cases.input: Verify code blocks have syntax highlighting
test_cases.expected: Code blocks use Prism.js or similar for syntax highlighting (bash, toml, rust)

test_cases.input: Check for link to full documentation
test_cases.expected: Section contains a link or button to access complete documentation

scenarios.name: Configuration Reference Section
scenarios.description: Verify the configuration section documents all key configuration options as specified in REQ-5

steps.description: Scroll or navigate to the configuration reference section
steps.context: Configuration options should be clearly documented

steps.description: Check that all key configuration options are documented with descriptions
steps.context: Options include: addr, work_dir, mem_table_max_size, sst_max_size, etc.

Configuration documents work directory option
Configuration documents mem_table_max_size option
Configuration documents sst_max_size option

scenarios.name: Comparison Section
scenarios.description: Verify the comparison section clearly differentiates MirDB from Memcached and Redis as specified in REQ-6

steps.description: Scroll or navigate to the comparison section
steps.context: Section should help users evaluate MirDB against alternatives

steps.description: Check that a comparison table is present with MirDB, Memcached, and Redis columns
steps.context: Table should highlight key differences

steps.description: Check that guidance on when to choose MirDB is provided
steps.context: Should clarify use cases where MirDB is the best choice

test_cases.expected: Table contains columns for Feature, MirDB, Memcached, and Redis
Table shows MirDB: Yes, Memcached: No, Redis: Yes for persistence
Table shows MirDB uses Memcached protocol, Redis uses Redis protocol
Table shows MirDB uses LSM tree, Redis uses RDB/AOF

test_cases.input: Check for use case guidance text
test_cases.expected: Section contains text explaining when to choose MirDB over alternatives

scenarios.name: Accessibility Compliance
scenarios.description: Verify the homepage meets WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility standards as specified in NFR-3

steps.description: Use axe-core or similar tool to audit page accessibility
steps.context: Automated testing for common accessibility issues

steps.description: Navigate entire page using only keyboard (Tab, Enter, Arrow keys)
steps.context: All interactive elements must be keyboard accessible

steps.description: Check that text has sufficient contrast against backgrounds
steps.context: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text

steps.description: Check all images have appropriate alt text
steps.context: Decorative images should have empty alt, informative images should describe content

test_cases.input: Run axe-core accessibility audit on homepage
test_cases.expected: No critical or serious accessibility violations
All buttons, links, and form elements receive focus in logical order

test_cases.input: Check color contrast of body text against background
test_cases.expected: Contrast ratio is at least 4.5:1

test_cases.input: Check all img elements for alt attributes
test_cases.expected: All images have alt attributes with appropriate text

test_cases.input: Check for skip link to main content
test_cases.expected: Page has skip link that appears on focus and skips to main content
Focused elements have visible focus outline/ring
